votes.motion: Enter Executive Session by roll call to discuss strategy related to contract negotiations and return to the meeting afterward.
votes.quote: by roll call vote each member voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy related to contract negotiations

votes.motion: Adopt a Grease Trap Fee & Review policy allowing the Commission to hire a firm to review future grease traps, with the applicant paying for the review.
votes.quote: it was unanimously approved by the commission

votes.motion: Increase sewer rates by 20% effective January 1, 2012, while keeping the current minimum usage charge.
votes.quote: it was unanimously voted to increase the rates by 20% effective january 1, 2012, but to keep the current minimum usage charge

votes.motion: Enter Executive Session by unanimous roll call to discuss litigation (Hollis Hills), adjourn the regular meeting, and not return after the executive session.
votes.quote: through a unanimous roll call the commission voted to enter executive session for the purposes of discussing litigation (hollis hills)

decisions.decision: The Commission plans to perform the corrective actions for the smoke and dye testing defects, including paying for cover seals on manholes outside the study area that are depressed and collecting water (about $200 per cover).
decisions.quote: the commission plans to perform the corrective actions

decisions.decision: Commission will pay for cover seals on any other depressed manholes outside the study area that collect water.
decisions.quote: it was also decided that if there are any other manholes in the system outside of the study area that are also depressed and collecting water, we will pay for the cover seals for them

decisions.decision: Weston and Sampson will draft a letter for the Commission to send to property owners of the 54 connected buildings that did not smoke.
decisions.quote: weston and sampson will draft a letter for the commission to send to these property owners

decisions.decision: Commission prefers that Corey perform internal building inspections over the winter and will proceed with owners who allow inspection, while Weston and Sampson research the Commission's authority.
decisions.quote: the commission stated that we would prefer to have corey perform such inspections over the winter.

decisions.decision: Commission will proceed with internal inspections for property owners willing to allow them.
decisions.quote: we will proceed for those property owners who are willing to allow the inspection

decisions.decision: Rate increase to be communicated through a flyer in the January billing and a communication to the Lunenburg Ledger.
decisions.quote: this will be communicated through a flyer in the january billing as well as a communication to the lunenburg ledger.

decisions.decision: Commission wants to explore other rate structures in the future and asked for information on how other communities set up their rates.
decisions.quote: the commission wants to explore other rate structures in the future

decisions.decision: Weston and Sampson will send a copy of the FY12 general-advice contract proposal; the Commission will review it at a January meeting.
decisions.quote: they will send us a copy and we will review it at a meeting in january.

decisions.decision: Next regular Sewer meeting set for January 11, 2012 at the Ritter Building; the December 27 meeting was cancelled.
decisions.quote: regular sewer meeting - january 11, 2012 at the ritter building.

budget_items.topic: Smoke and dye testing corrective action
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Most of the cost to correct the defects will fall on property owners or the school department; the Commission's own share is seals on manholes and repair of internal I/I in two manholes.
budget_items.quote: most of the $62,000 cost for correcting the problems will be the responsibility of the property owners or school department

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Commission will pay for cover seals on depressed manholes outside the study area, estimated at $200 per cover.
budget_items.quote: we will pay for the cover seals for them - estimated to cost $200 per cover

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Weston and Sampson estimated internal inspections of 450 buildings would cost $61,000.
budget_items.quote: their estimate of the cost for 450 buildings was $61,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rates raised 20% effective January 1, 2012, citing the Fitchburg increase of about 11% and expected draw on retained earnings.
budget_items.quote: the impact of the fitchburg increase was about 11%

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Camera inspection of lateral pipes from the street to each property was estimated at $200 per property and recommended for spring; it may use remaining project funds.
budget_items.quote: weston and sampson estimated that would cost $200 for each property

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lateral camera work may qualify for use of the remaining project funds related to the system start-up; no amount stated.
budget_items.quote: may qualify for use of the remaining project funds as it relates to the start up of the system

topics.resolution: held; meeting resumed after executive session ended at 7:55 pm
topics.quote: this session ended at 7:55 pm, and the commission continued the meeting.
